source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶה הַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖יו עַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be at [the] end of the days, will be [the] mountain of [the] house of Yahweh established at [the] head of the mountains, and lifted up [will be] it above [the] hills, and will stream to it peoples.

en.L: And it will be at the end of the days [that] the mountain of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be established at the head of the mountains, \q and it [will be] lifted up above the hills, \q and peoples will stream to it.
en.B: In days to come, the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house will stand firm, the chief of all the mountains, \q rising high above the hills, \q and peoples will stream toward it.
en.R: In the future, the mountain where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple stands will become the greatest mountain of all. \q It will rise higher than any hill. \q Peoples will come to it like a river flowing in.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra trong những ngày cuối cùng, núi của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được lập vững trên đỉnh các núi, \q nó [sẽ được] nâng cao hơn các đồi, \q và các dân sẽ đổ về đó.
vi.B: Trong những ngày sắp tới, núi của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được lập vững, đứng đầu mọi núi, \q vượt cao hơn các đồi, \q và các dân sẽ lũ lượt kéo về đó.
vi.R: Trong tương lai, ngọn núi nơi có đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trở thành ngọn núi lớn nhất. \q Núi ấy sẽ cao hơn mọi ngọn đồi. \q Các dân sẽ kéo đến đó như dòng sông chảy về.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, à la fin des jours, [que] la montagne de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera établie à la tête des montagnes, \q et elle [sera] élevée au-dessus des collines, \q et des peuples afflueront vers elle.
fr.B: Dans les jours à venir, la montagne de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se dressera, solide, la première de toutes les montagnes, \q plus haute que les collines, \q et des peuples afflueront vers elle.
fr.R: Dans l’avenir, la montagne où se trouve le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} deviendra la plus grande de toutes les montagnes. \q Elle sera plus haute que toutes les collines. \q Des peuples y viendront, comme un fleuve qui coule vers elle.

es.L: Y sucederá al final de los días [que] el monte de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} quedará firme a la cabeza de los montes, \q y [será] elevado por encima de las colinas, \q y fluirán hacia él los pueblos.
es.B: En los días venideros, el monte de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estará firme, el principal de todos los montes, \q alzándose por encima de las colinas, \q y los pueblos acudirán a él como un río.
es.R: En el futuro, el monte donde está el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llegará a ser el monte más importante de todos. \q Se alzará más alto que cualquier colina. \q Los pueblos llegarán a él como un río que corre.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku za mwisho, [kwamba] mlima wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utaimarishwa juu ya vilele vya milima, \q nao [utainuliwa] juu kuliko vilima, \q na watu watamiminika kwake.
sw.B: Katika siku zijazo, mlima wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utasimama imara, mkuu kuliko milima yote, \q ukiinuka juu kuliko vilima, \q nao watu wa mataifa watatiririka kuuelekea.
sw.R: Siku zijazo, mlima ambapo hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} limesimama utakuwa mlima mkuu kuliko yote. \q Utakuwa juu kuliko kilima chochote. \q Watu wengi watakuja kwake kama mto unaotiririka.

ko.L: 그리고 마지막 날들에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 산이 산들의 꼭대기에 굳게 설 것이고, \q 그것이 언덕들 위로 높이 들릴 것이며, \q 백성들이 그리로 흘러들 것이다.
ko.B: 장차 올 날에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집이 있는 산이 모든 산 가운데 으뜸으로 굳게 서고, \q 언덕들보다 높이 솟을 것이니, \q 백성들이 그리로 물밀듯 몰려올 것이다.
ko.R: 앞으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전이 서 있는 산이 모든 산 가운데 가장 높은 산이 될 것이다. \q 그 산은 어느 언덕보다도 높이 솟을 것이다. \q 여러 백성이 강물이 흘러들듯 그곳으로 몰려올 것이다.

pt.L: E acontecerá no fim dos dias [que] o monte da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} estará firmado no topo dos montes, \q e ele [será] elevado acima das colinas, \q e povos fluirão para ele.
pt.B: Nos dias que virão, o monte da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficará firme, o principal de todos os montes, \q erguendo-se bem acima das colinas, \q e povos fluirão para ele.
pt.R: No futuro, o monte onde fica o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vai ser o maior de todos os montes. \q Ele vai ficar mais alto que qualquer colina. \q Povos vão chegar até ele, como um rio que corre para lá.

am.L: በቀኖቹም መጨረሻ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት ተራራ በተራሮች ራስ ላይ ጸንቶ ይቆማል፤ \q እርሱም ከኮረብቶች በላይ ከፍ [ይላል]፤ \q ወገኖችም ወደ እርሱ ይጎርፋሉ።
am.B: በሚመጣው ዘመን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ ያለበት ተራራ ከተራሮች ሁሉ የበለጠ ሆኖ ጸንቶ ይቆማል፤ \q ከኮረብቶችም በላይ ከፍ ብሎ ይታያል፤ \q ሕዝቦችም ወደ እርሱ ይጎርፋሉ።
am.R: ወደ ፊት {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ የቆመበት ተራራ ከተራሮች ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ይሆናል። \q ከማንኛውም ኮረብታ በላይ ከፍ ይላል። \q ሕዝቦች እንደሚጎርፍ ወንዝ ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ።

hi.L: और दिनों के अंत में ऐसा होगा कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन का पर्वत पर्वतों के सिर पर स्थिर किया जाएगा, \q और वह पहाड़ियों से ऊपर उठाया जाएगा, \q और लोग धारा की तरह उसकी ओर बहेंगे।
hi.B: आनेवाले दिनों में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन का पर्वत दृढ़ खड़ा होगा, सब पर्वतों में सबसे ऊँचा, \q पहाड़ियों से बहुत ऊपर उठा हुआ, \q और देश-देश के लोग धारा की तरह उसकी ओर उमड़ पड़ेंगे।
hi.R: भविष्य में वह पर्वत, जिस पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का मंदिर खड़ा है, सब पर्वतों में सबसे महान हो जाएगा। \q वह हर पहाड़ी से ऊँचा उठेगा। \q देश-देश के लोग नदी की धारा की तरह उसकी ओर बहते हुए आएँगे।

ru.L: И будет в конце дней: утверждена будет гора дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} во главе гор, \q и она вознесена [будет] над холмами, \q и потекут к ней племена.
ru.B: В грядущие дни гора дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} будет стоять твёрдо, первая среди гор, \q возвышаясь над холмами, \q и племена потекут к ней.
ru.R: В будущем гора, где стоит храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, станет самой великой из всех гор. \q Она поднимется выше любого холма. \q Народы будут стекаться к ней, словно река.

uk.L: І буде в кінці днів, [що] гора дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} буде утверджена на вершині гір, \q і вона [буде] піднесена над пагорбами, \q і потечуть до неї народи.
uk.B: У прийдешні дні гора дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} стоятиме міцно, найвища з усіх гір, \q здіймаючись над пагорбами, \q і народи потечуть до неї.
uk.R: У майбутньому гора, на якій стоїть храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, стане найбільшою з усіх гір. \q Вона здійматиметься вище за будь-який пагорб. \q Народи прийдуть до неї, мов ріка, що вливається.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 2:2-4 has the same prophecy
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 appear almost word for word in Isaiah 2:2-4. Isaiah and Micah prophesied in the same years (Isaiah 1:1; Micah 1:1); the text does not say whether one took the oracle from the other or both used an older one. Here the order of two words differs, Micah adds "it" before "lifted up", and Micah has "peoples" where Isaiah has "all the nations"; in verses 2-3 Micah has "nations" and "peoples" where Isaiah has them the other way round. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: at the end of the days: in the time to come, the future God has in view
decisions.reason: The phrase points beyond the present to a coming time when God's purpose is fulfilled (Genesis 49:1; Numbers 24:14; Deuteronomy 4:30). It does not by itself mean the end of the world. The New Testament speaks of "the last days" as having begun (Acts 2:17; Hebrews 1:2).

decisions.choice: the mountain of the house: the temple hill of 3:12, raised above every height
decisions.reason: The last verse of chapter 3 said that "the mountain of the house" would become an overgrown height. The next words promise that the same mountain will be the chief of all mountains, and the nations will flow to it. Mount Zion is not a tall mountain: the picture is of its honor as the place where God is worshiped (Psalm 48:2-3). Rivers do not flow uphill; the nations streaming up to it is itself a wonder.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:2 at each level, with "peoples" for Isaiah's "all the nations" and "it" (L)
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the published Isaiah 2:2: "at the end of the days" (L), "In days to come" (B) and "In the future" (R); "the chief of all the mountains" (B); "like a river flowing in" (R). Where Micah's Hebrew differs (m1), the wording follows Micah.

decisions.choice: the published Isaiah 2:2 at each level, with "các dân" for Isaiah's "mọi dân tộc" and "nó" at Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Isaiah 2:2-4 has the same prophecy; the terms note asks that a parallel reuse the published wording where the Hebrew is the same and change only what the Hebrew changes. "Trong những ngày cuối cùng / sắp tới / tương lai" is the terms note's wording for "the latter days".

decisions.choice: The published Isaiah 2:2-4 at each level for 4:1-3, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs: "des peuples" for Isaiah's "toutes les nations" (4:1), "des nations" for "des peuples" (4:2), "des peuples nombreux ... des nations puissantes, jusqu'au loin" (4:3), "et elle [sera] élevée" (L)
decisions.reason: The term sheet asks for the published parallel to be reused where the Hebrew is the same, with each difference named.

decisions.choice: the published Spanish of Isaiah 2:2 at each level, with "los pueblos" for Isaiah's "todas las naciones"
decisions.reason: Micah 4:1-3 is the same prophecy as Isaiah 2:2-4, so the Spanish reuses Isaiah's lines and changes only what Micah's Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: Micah 4:1-3 reuses the Korean Isaiah 2:2-4 at each level, changing only what Micah's Hebrew changes: here "백성들" for Isaiah's "모든 민족"
decisions.reason: The same prophecy stands in Isaiah 2:2-4 (meaning decision); as the term sheet asks, the published Korean is reused so that a reader sees the parallel, and each difference is named. "마지막 날들에" (L) and "장차 올 날에" (B) are Isaiah's wording, which speak of a coming time without suggesting the end of the world.

decisions.choice: The published Swahili of Isaiah 2:2-4 at each level in Micah 4:1-3, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs
decisions.reason: The two prophets have the same oracle (term sheet: Micah 4:1-3 reuses Isaiah 2:2-4). Here Micah has "peoples" ("watu") where Isaiah has "all the nations" ("mataifa yote"); in 4:2-3 Micah has "many nations" and "many peoples ... mighty nations far away", and the Swahili changes the same words.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Isaiah 2:2-4 at each level, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs (verses 1-3)
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 are the oracle of Isaiah 2:2-4 (m1), whose Portuguese was worded to serve Micah too. Each level takes Isaiah's sentences ("no fim dos dias", "Nos dias que virão", "No futuro"; "fluirão para ele"; "lâminas de arado", "facas de podar") and changes only what Micah's Hebrew changes: "povos" for "todas as nações" and the added "ele" here, "muitas nações" and "e à casa" in verse 2, "muitos povos" and "nações poderosas" far away in verse 3.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Isaiah 2:2 at each level, with "ወገኖች" (L) and "ሕዝቦች" (B, R) for Micah's "peoples" in place of Isaiah's "all the nations", and "እርሱም" (L) for Micah's added "it"
decisions.reason: Isaiah 2:2-4 is the same prophecy, drafted first; where the Hebrew is the same the Amharic is copied level by level. Isaiah's draft keeps "ወገኖች" for ʿammim and "አሕዛብ" for goyim at Literal, so the swap of the two words in Micah shows there. The divine name takes the possessive prefix inside both options ("{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}}"), as the terms lists ask, where Isaiah's draft has it outside the span.

decisions.choice: 4:1-3 reuse the Ukrainian of Isaiah 2:2-4 (the open uk-isaiah draft) at each level, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs: "народи" for "всі народи", "численні народи" in 4:2, and in 4:3 "між численними племенами ... могутні народи далеко"
decisions.reason: The two prophets give the same oracle; the English reuses Isaiah's wording, and the Ukrainian does the same so that the reader can see where the two agree and where Micah differs.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:2 at each level, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs
decisions.reason: Micah 4:1-3 is the same prophecy as Isaiah 2:2-4, which is already drafted in Hindi. Each level copies Isaiah's Hindi at that level and changes only what Micah's Hebrew changes: here Micah says "it will be lifted up" (L वह ... उठाया जाएगा) and "peoples will stream" where Isaiah has "all the nations" (L लोग ... बहेंगे; B and R देश-देश के लोग, Isaiah 2:3's words for the peoples).

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:2 at each level, changed only where the Hebrew differs
decisions.reason: Micah 4:1-3 is the same prophecy as Isaiah 2:2-4; each level copies the Russian of Isaiah. Here Micah adds "it" ("и она вознесена", L) and has "peoples" where Isaiah has "all the nations", so Russian says "племена" (L, B) and "Народы" (R, where Isaiah's Readable says "Люди из всех народов").

source.text: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיוֹרֵ֨נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will go nations many and say, Come and let us go up to [the] mountain of Yahweh and to [the] house of [the] God of Jacob, and he will teach us from his ways, and we will walk in his paths; for from Zion will go out instruction, and [the] word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

en.L: And many nations will go and say, "Come, and let us ascend to the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to the house of Jacob's God, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may teach us from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, and we may walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths." \q For from Zion will go out instruction, \q and the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Jerusalem.
en.B: Nations in great numbers will set out, saying, "Come, let us climb to the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, up to the house of Jacob's God, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may show us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways and we may walk on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} paths." \q For instruction will go out from Zion, \q and the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Jerusalem.
en.R: Many nations will come and say, "Let us go up to the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Let us go to the temple of the God of Israel. \q He will teach us how to live, and we will do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says." \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}'s teaching will go out from Zion. \q His word will go out from Jerusalem.

vi.L: Nhiều dân tộc sẽ đi và nói: "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy lên núi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và lên nhà của Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy chúng ta đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và chúng ta sẽ bước đi trong các nẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \q Vì từ Si-ôn luật pháp sẽ ra, \q và lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Đông đảo các dân tộc sẽ lên đường và nói: "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy lên núi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lên nhà Đức Chúa Trời của Gia-cốp, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ dạy chúng ta đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và chúng ta bước đi trong các nẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \q Vì lời dạy dỗ sẽ ra từ Si-ôn, \q và lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Nhiều dân tộc sẽ đến và nói: "Chúng ta hãy lên núi của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chúng ta hãy đến đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ngài sẽ dạy chúng ta cách sống, và chúng ta sẽ làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán." \q Lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ra từ Si-ôn. \q Lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ra từ Giê-ru-sa-lem.

fr.L: Et des nations nombreuses iront et diront : « Venez, et montons à la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et à la maison du Dieu de Jacob, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous enseignera [quelque chose] de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies, et nous marcherons dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sentiers. » \q Car de Sion sortira la loi, \q et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Des nations en grand nombre se mettront en route et diront : « Venez, montons à la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, à la maison du Dieu de Jacob, \q pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous montre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins et que nous marchions dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} sentiers. » \q Car c’est de Sion que sortira l’instruction, \q et de Jérusalem la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Beaucoup de nations viendront et diront : « Montons à la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Allons au temple du Dieu d’Israël. \q Il nous apprendra comment vivre, et nous ferons ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit. » \q L’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sortira de Sion. \q Sa parole sortira de Jérusalem.

es.L: Y irán muchas naciones y dirán: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y subamos al monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y a la casa del Dios de Jacob, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos enseñará de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, y andaremos por {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas». \q Porque de Sion saldrá la instrucción, \q y de Jerusalén la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Naciones numerosas se pondrán en camino, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, subamos al monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la casa del Dios de Jacob, \q para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos muestre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos y andemos por {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sendas». \q Porque de Sion saldrá la instrucción, \q y de Jerusalén la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Muchas naciones vendrán y dirán: «Subamos al monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Vamos al templo del Dios de Israel. \q Él nos enseñará cómo vivir, y haremos lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice». \q La enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} saldrá de Sion. \q Su palabra saldrá de Jerusalén.

sw.L: Na mataifa mengi watakwenda na kusema, "Njooni, na tupande kwenda mlimani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kwenye nyumba ya Mungu wa Yakobo, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atatufundisha njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, nasi tutatembea katika mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}." \q Kwa maana kutoka Sayuni itatoka sheria, \q na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Watu wa mataifa mengi watakwenda wakisema, "Njooni, tupande mlimani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hadi nyumbani mwa Mungu wa Yakobo, \q ili atuonyeshe njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, nasi tutembee katika mapito {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}." \q Kwa maana mafundisho yatatoka Sayuni, \q na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Watu wa mataifa mengi watakuja na kusema, "Twendeni juu mlimani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Twendeni hekaluni mwa Mungu wa Israeli. \q Atatufundisha jinsi ya kuishi, nasi tutafanya anayosema." \q Mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yatatoka Sayuni. \q Neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} litatoka Yerusalemu.

ko.L: 그리고 많은 민족들이 가서 말할 것이다. "오너라, 우리가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 산으로, 야곱의 하나님의 집으로 올라가자. \q 그러면 그분께서 그분의 길들 가운데서 우리를 가르치실 것이고, 우리가 그분의 길로 걸을 것이다." \q 가르침이 시온에서 나오고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예루살렘에서 나올 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 많은 민족들이 길을 나서며 말할 것이다. "자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 산으로 올라가자. 야곱의 하나님의 집으로 올라가자. \q 그분께서 우리에게 그분의 길을 가르쳐 주시면, 우리가 그 길로 걸어가겠다." \q 가르침이 시온에서 나오고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예루살렘에서 나올 것이다.
ko.R: 많은 민족이 와서 말할 것이다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 산으로 올라가자. 이스라엘의 하나님의 성전으로 가자. \q 그분께서 우리에게 어떻게 살아야 하는지 가르쳐 주실 것이다. 우리는 그분께서 말씀하시는 대로 살 것이다." \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침이 시온에서 나갈 것이다. \q 그분의 말씀이 예루살렘에서 나갈 것이다.

pt.L: E muitas nações irão e dirão: "Venham, e subamos ao monte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e à casa do Deus de Jacó, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos instruirá nos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos, e caminharemos pelas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} sendas." \q Porque de Sião sairá a instrução, \q e a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Nações numerosas se porão a caminho, dizendo: "Venham, vamos subir ao monte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, à casa do Deus de Jacó, \q para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos mostre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} caminhos e nós andemos pelas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} trilhas." \q Pois de Sião sairá a instrução, \q e de Jerusalém, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Muitas nações virão e dirão: "Vamos subir ao monte {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Vamos ao templo do Deus de Israel. \q Ele vai nos ensinar como viver, e nós vamos fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz." \q O ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vai sair de Sião. \q A palavra {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} vai sair de Jerusalém.

am.L: ብዙ አሕዛብም ሄደው እንዲህ ይላሉ፦ «ኑ፤ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተራራ፣ ወደ ያዕቆብም አምላክ ቤት እንውጣ፤ \q ከመንገዶቹም ያስተምረናል፤ በጎዳናዎቹም እንሄዳለን።» \q ከጽዮን ትምህርት፣ \q ከኢየሩሳሌምም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ይወጣልና።
am.B: ብዙ ሕዝቦች እንዲህ እያሉ ይነሣሉ፦ «ኑ፤ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተራራ፣ ወደ ያዕቆብ አምላክ ቤት እንውጣ፤ \q መንገዶቹን ያሳየናል፤ እኛም በጎዳናዎቹ እንሄዳለን።» \q ትምህርት ከጽዮን፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃልም ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወጣልና።
am.R: ብዙ ሕዝቦች መጥተው እንዲህ ይላሉ፦ «ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተራራ እንውጣ። ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ ቤተ መቅደስ እንሂድ። \q እንዴት መኖር እንዳለብን ያስተምረናል፤ እኛም የሚለውን እናደርጋለን።» \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ትምህርት ከጽዮን ይወጣል። \q ቃሉም ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወጣል።

hi.L: और बहुत-सी जातियाँ जाएँगी और कहेंगी, "आओ, हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पर्वत पर, और याकूब के परमेश्वर के भवन को चढ़ चलें, \q और वे हमें अपने मार्गों में से सिखाएँगे, और हम उनके पथों पर चलेंगे।" \q क्योंकि सिय्योन से शिक्षा निकलेगी, \q और यरूशलेम से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन।
hi.B: बड़ी संख्या में राष्ट्र यह कहते हुए निकल पड़ेंगे, "आओ, हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पर्वत पर चढ़ें, याकूब के परमेश्वर के भवन तक, \q ताकि वे हमें अपने मार्ग दिखाएँ और हम उनके पथों पर चलें।" \q क्योंकि शिक्षा सिय्योन से निकलेगी, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन यरूशलेम से।
hi.R: बहुत-से राष्ट्र आकर कहेंगे, "आओ, हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के पर्वत पर चढ़ें। आओ, हम इस्राएल के परमेश्वर के मंदिर में चलें। \q वे हमें सिखाएँगे कि हमें कैसे जीना चाहिए, और हम वही करेंगे जो वे कहते हैं।" \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शिक्षा सिय्योन से निकलेगी। \q उनका वचन यरूशलेम से निकलेगा।

ru.L: И пойдут многие народы и скажут: «Придите, и взойдём на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и в дом Бога Иакова, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} научит нас своим путям, и мы будем ходить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} стезями.» \q Потому что из Сиона выйдет наставление, \q и слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — из Иерусалима.
ru.B: Множество народов двинется в путь со словами: «Придите, поднимемся на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, к дому Бога Иакова, \q чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} показал нам свои пути и мы ходили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} стезями.» \q Ведь из Сиона выйдет наставление, \q и слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — из Иерусалима.
ru.R: Многие народы придут и скажут: «Поднимемся на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Пойдём в храм Бога Израиля. \q Он научит нас, как жить, и мы будем делать то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит.» \q Наставление {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} выйдет из Сиона. \q Его слово выйдет из Иерусалима.

uk.L: І підуть численні народи, і скажуть: «Ходіть, і зійдімо на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і до дому Бога Якова, \q щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} навчив нас своїх доріг, і ми ходили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} стежками.» \q Бо із Сіону вийде настанова, \q і слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} — з Єрусалима.
uk.B: Безліч народів вирушить, кажучи: «Ходіть, зійдімо на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, до дому Бога Якова, \q щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} показав нам свої дороги, а ми ходили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} стежками.» \q Бо настанова вийде із Сіону, \q і слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} — з Єрусалима.
uk.R: Багато народів прийдуть і скажуть: «Зійдімо на гору {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. Підімо до храму Бога Ізраїлю. \q Він навчить нас, як жити, і ми робитимемо те, що {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} каже.» \q Навчання {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} вийде із Сіону. \q Його слово вийде з Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 2:3, with "nations" for Isaiah's "peoples"
decisions.reason: The verse is Isaiah 2:3, except that Micah says "many nations" where Isaiah says "many peoples", and Micah has "and to the house" where Isaiah has "to the house". The two words for the nations of the world are used side by side and mean the same here.

decisions.choice: instruction: God's teaching for how to live
decisions.reason: The word means teaching or direction, the guidance a parent or priest gives. It can name the law of Moses, but here it is the instruction the nations come to learn, set beside "the word of the LORD". In Micah 3:11 Jerusalem's priests taught for a price; here the LORD himself teaches.

decisions.choice: the nations' words end with "his paths"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no quotation marks. The last two lines, "for from Zion instruction will go out", are read here as the prophet's own explanation of why the nations come, as in Isaiah 2:3. They may also be the end of what the nations say.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:3 at each level, with "nations" for "peoples"; at Literal, "and to", "ascend" and "Jacob's God"
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the published Isaiah 2:3, changed only where Micah's Hebrew differs (m1): "many nations" (L, R) and "Nations in great numbers" (B). Readable says "Israel" for "Jacob" and "teaching" for instruction, as there. Literal says "ascend", "Jacob's God" and "so that he may teach", which the Hebrew allows equally.

decisions.choice: the published Isaiah 2:3 at each level, with "dân tộc" for Micah's "nations" where Isaiah has "dân" (peoples), and "và lên" at Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Micah has "nations" for Isaiah's "peoples"; only that is changed. "Torah" is "luật pháp" (L), "lời dạy dỗ" (B), "lời dạy" (R), as Isaiah 2:3.

decisions.choice: torah "la loi" (L), "l'instruction" (B), "l'enseignement" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and published Isaiah 2:3.

decisions.choice: the published Spanish of Isaiah 2:3, with "naciones" for "pueblos" and, at Literal, "y a la casa"
decisions.reason: Micah's Hebrew differs from Isaiah's only in these words.

decisions.choice: The Korean Isaiah 2:3, with "민족들" for Isaiah's "백성들"
decisions.reason: Micah has "nations" where Isaiah has "peoples" (meaning decision), so the two words change places; the rest is Isaiah's published Korean.

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Isaiah 2:3 at each level, with "ብዙ አሕዛብ" (L) for Micah's "many nations" and "ወደ ያዕቆብም አምላክ ቤት" (L) for Micah's "and to the house"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew differs from Isaiah's only in the word for the nations and the added "and"; Balanced and Readable already say "ሕዝቦች" for both words, so they are Isaiah's wording unchanged.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:3 at each level, with "nations" for "peoples"
decisions.reason: Each level copies its Hindi of Isaiah 2:3. Micah's Hebrew has "many nations" where Isaiah has "many peoples", so Literal says बहुत-सी जातियाँ and Balanced and Readable राष्ट्र (the nations-word of the poetry note) where Isaiah says लोग; Literal adds और before "to the house", as Micah's Hebrew does. Torah is शिक्षा, as set for the Prophets.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:3, with "народы" for the nations
decisions.reason: Micah has "many nations" where Isaiah has "many peoples", so Literal and Balanced say "народы" where Isaiah's Russian says "племена"; Literal adds "и" before "в дом", as Micah's Hebrew does. Torah is "наставление" at every level, as set for the Prophets.

source.text: וְשָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֛יחַ לְגוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד־רָח֑וֹק וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא־יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־יִלְמְד֥וּן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will judge between peoples many and decide for nations mighty to far away; and they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning knives; not will lift up nation against nation sword, and not they will learn again war.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will judge between many peoples \q and will decide for mighty nations far away, \q and they will hammer their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning knives. \q Nation will not lift up sword against nation, \q and they will not learn war again.
en.B: He will be judge between many peoples \q and settle the cases of mighty nations far away. \q They will hammer their swords into plow blades and their spears into knives for pruning. \q No nation will raise the sword against another, \q and they will no longer learn how to wage war.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will settle arguments between many peoples \q and make fair decisions for strong nations, even those far away. \q They will take their swords and hammer them into blades for plowing. They will turn their spears into knives for trimming vines. \q Nations will stop fighting one another. \q People will not even learn how to fight wars anymore.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ xét xử giữa nhiều dân, \q và phân xử cho các dân tộc hùng mạnh ở phương xa; \q họ sẽ rèn gươm mình thành lưỡi cày, và giáo mình thành lưỡi liềm. \q Dân tộc này sẽ không giơ gươm lên nghịch dân tộc kia, \q và họ sẽ không còn học tập chiến tranh nữa.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ làm thẩm phán giữa nhiều dân \q và phân xử cho các dân tộc hùng mạnh ở phương xa. \q Họ sẽ đập gươm thành lưỡi cày, đập giáo thành dao tỉa cành. \q Không dân tộc nào còn vung gươm đánh dân tộc khác, \q và họ sẽ chẳng còn tập luyện chiến tranh nữa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải quyết những tranh chấp giữa nhiều dân \q và phân xử công bằng cho các dân tộc hùng mạnh, kể cả những dân ở phương xa. \q Họ sẽ lấy gươm đập thành lưỡi cày. Họ sẽ biến giáo thành dao để tỉa cây nho. \q Các dân tộc sẽ thôi đánh nhau. \q Người ta sẽ không còn học cách đánh giặc nữa.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} jugera entre des peuples nombreux \q et décidera pour des nations puissantes, jusqu’au loin, \q et ils forgeront leurs épées en socs de charrue et leurs lances en serpes. \q Une nation ne lèvera plus l’épée contre une nation, \q et ils n’apprendront plus la guerre.
fr.B: Il sera juge entre des peuples nombreux \q et tranchera les litiges de nations puissantes, jusqu’aux plus lointaines. \q Ils martèleront leurs épées pour en faire des socs et leurs lances pour en faire des serpes. \q Aucune nation ne lèvera l’épée contre une autre, \q et on n’apprendra plus à faire la guerre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réglera les disputes entre beaucoup de peuples \q et prendra des décisions justes pour des nations puissantes, même lointaines. \q Ils prendront leurs épées et les marteleront pour en faire des lames de charrue. Ils transformeront leurs lances en couteaux pour tailler la vigne. \q Les nations arrêteront de se battre entre elles. \q Les gens n’apprendront même plus à faire la guerre.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzgará entre muchos pueblos \q y decidirá por naciones poderosas hasta lejos, \q y forjarán sus espadas en rejas de arado y sus lanzas en podaderas. \q No alzará espada nación contra nación, \q y no aprenderán más la guerra.
es.B: Él será juez entre muchos pueblos \q y resolverá los pleitos de naciones poderosas y lejanas. \q Martillarán sus espadas hasta hacer de ellas hojas de arado, y de sus lanzas, cuchillos para podar. \q Ninguna nación levantará la espada contra otra, \q y ya no aprenderán a hacer la guerra.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} resolverá las disputas entre muchos pueblos \q y tomará decisiones justas para naciones fuertes, aun las que están lejos. \q Tomarán sus espadas y las martillarán hasta convertirlas en hojas para arar. Convertirán sus lanzas en cuchillos para podar las vides. \q Las naciones dejarán de pelear unas contra otras. \q La gente ni siquiera aprenderá a hacer la guerra.

sw.L: Naye atahukumu kati ya watu wengi \q na kuamua mashauri ya mataifa yenye nguvu yaliyo mbali, \q nao watafua panga zao kuwa majembe na mikuki yao kuwa miundu. \q Taifa halitainua upanga juu ya taifa, \q wala hawatajifunza vita tena.
sw.B: Atakuwa mwamuzi kati ya watu wengi \q na kuyamaliza mashauri ya mataifa yenye nguvu yaliyo mbali. \q Watazifua panga zao kuwa majembe, na mikuki yao kuwa visu vya kupogolea. \q Hakuna taifa litakaloinua upanga dhidi ya taifa jingine, \q wala hawatajifunza tena kupigana vita.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atamaliza mabishano kati ya watu wengi \q na kuamua kwa haki kwa ajili ya mataifa yenye nguvu, hata yale yaliyo mbali. \q Watachukua panga zao na kuzifua kuwa majembe ya kulimia. Watageuza mikuki yao kuwa visu vya kupogolea mizabibu. \q Mataifa yataacha kupigana. \q Watu hawatajifunza tena hata jinsi ya kupigana vita.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 많은 백성들 사이를 재판하시고 먼 곳의 강한 민족들을 위하여 판결하실 것이니, \q 그들이 자기 칼들을 두들겨 보습들로, 자기 창들을 가지 치는 낫들로 만들 것이다. \q 민족이 민족을 향하여 칼을 들지 않고, \q 그들이 다시는 전쟁을 배우지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 많은 백성들 사이에서 재판관이 되시고, 멀리 있는 강한 민족들의 다툼을 판결해 주실 것이다. \q 그러면 그들이 칼을 두드려 쟁기 날을 만들고, 창을 두드려 가지 치는 낫을 만들 것이다. \q 어떤 민족도 다른 민족을 향해 칼을 들지 않고, \q 다시는 전쟁하는 법을 배우지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 많은 백성들 사이의 다툼을 해결하시고, 멀리 있는 강한 나라들에게도 공정한 판결을 내려 주실 것이다. \q 그들은 칼을 망치로 두드려 밭을 가는 쟁기 날로 만들 것이다. 창을 두드려 포도나무 가지를 치는 낫으로 만들 것이다. \q 나라들이 서로 싸우기를 그칠 것이다. \q 사람들은 더 이상 전쟁하는 법을 배우지도 않을 것이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} julgará entre muitos povos \q e decidirá para nações poderosas até longe, \q e eles forjarão as suas espadas em lâminas de arado e as suas lanças em facas de podar. \q Nação não erguerá espada contra nação, \q e não voltarão a aprender a guerra.
pt.B: Ele julgará entre muitos povos \q e resolverá as causas de nações poderosas e distantes. \q Eles martelarão as suas espadas até virarem lâminas de arado, e as suas lanças, até virarem facas de podar. \q Nenhuma nação levantará a espada contra outra, \q e não aprenderão mais a fazer guerra.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai resolver as brigas entre muitos povos \q e decidir com justiça as questões de nações fortes, mesmo as que estão longe. \q Eles vão pegar as suas espadas e martelar até virarem lâminas de arado. Vão transformar as suas lanças em facas para podar parreiras. \q As nações vão parar de lutar umas contra as outras. \q As pessoas nem vão mais aprender a fazer guerra.

am.L: በብዙ ወገኖችም መካከል ይፈርዳል፤ \q በሩቅ ላሉ ብርቱዎች አሕዛብም ይበይናል፤ \q ሰይፎቻቸውንም ማረሻ፣ ጦሮቻቸውንም ማጭድ አድርገው ይቀጠቅጣሉ። \q ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ ሰይፍ አያነሣም፤ \q ዳግመኛም ጦርነትን አይማሩም።
am.B: በብዙ ሕዝቦች መካከል ፈራጅ ይሆናል፤ \q በሩቅ ያሉትን የብርቱ ሕዝቦች ክርክር ይቋጫል። \q ሰይፎቻቸውን ቀጥቅጠው የማረሻ ብረት፣ ጦሮቻቸውንም የመግረዣ ቢላዋ ያደርጓቸዋል። \q ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ ሰይፍ አያነሣም፤ \q ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ ጦርነትን አይማሩም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በብዙ ሕዝቦች መካከል ያለውን ክርክር ይፈታል፤ \q በሩቅ ላሉትም እንኳ ለብርቱ ሕዝቦች ትክክለኛ ውሳኔ ይሰጣል። \q ሰይፎቻቸውን ወስደው ለማረሻ የሚሆን ብረት አድርገው ይቀጠቅጧቸዋል። ጦሮቻቸውንም ወይን መከርከሚያ ቢላዋ ያደርጓቸዋል። \q ሕዝቦች እርስ በርሳቸው መዋጋታቸውን ያቆማሉ። \q ሰዎች ከእንግዲህ ጦርነት እንዴት እንደሚደረግ እንኳ አይማሩም።

hi.L: और वे बहुत-से लोगों के बीच न्याय करेंगे \q और दूर-दूर की सामर्थी जातियों के लिए फ़ैसला करेंगे, \q और वे अपनी तलवारों को कूटकर हल की फालें और अपने भालों को छँटाई की हँसियाँ बनाएँगे। \q जाति जाति के विरुद्ध तलवार न उठाएगी, \q और वे फिर युद्ध न सीखेंगे।
hi.B: वे बहुत-से लोगों के बीच न्यायी होंगे \q और दूर-दूर के शक्तिशाली राष्ट्रों के मुक़दमे निपटाएँगे। \q वे अपनी तलवारों को ठोंककर हल के फाल और अपने भालों को बेलें छाँटने के चाकू बनाएँगे। \q कोई देश दूसरे देश के विरुद्ध तलवार नहीं उठाएगा, \q और वे फिर कभी युद्ध करना नहीं सीखेंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बहुत-से लोगों के बीच झगड़े सुलझाएँगे \q और शक्तिशाली राष्ट्रों के लिए, दूर-दूर के राष्ट्रों के लिए भी, सही फ़ैसले करेंगे। \q वे अपनी तलवारें लेकर उन्हें पीट-पीटकर हल के फाल बनाएँगे। वे अपने भालों को बेलें छाँटने के चाकू बना देंगे। \q देश एक-दूसरे से लड़ना छोड़ देंगे। \q लोग फिर कभी युद्ध करना सीखेंगे भी नहीं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет судить между многими племенами \q и решать [споры] сильных народов вдали, \q и перекуют они свои мечи на лемехи и свои копья — на садовые ножи. \q Не поднимет народ против народа меча, \q и не будут больше учиться войне.
ru.B: Он будет судьёй между многими племенами \q и разрешит споры сильных народов вдали. \q Они перекуют свои мечи на лемехи плугов, а копья — на ножи для обрезки лоз. \q Ни один народ не поднимет меч на другой, \q и они больше не будут учиться воевать.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет решать споры между многими народами \q и выносить справедливые решения для сильных народов, даже далёких. \q Люди возьмут свои мечи и перекуют их на лемехи для плугов. Свои копья они превратят в ножи для подрезки виноградных лоз. \q Народы перестанут воевать друг с другом. \q Люди даже не будут больше учиться воевать.

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} судитиме між численними племенами \q і розсуджуватиме могутні народи далеко, \q і вони перекують свої мечі на лемеші, а свої списи — на садові ножі. \q Не підніме народ на народ меча, \q і не будуть більше вчитися війни.
uk.B: Він буде суддею між численними племенами \q і розсудить справи могутніх народів далеко. \q Вони перекують свої мечі на лемеші, а списи — на ножі для обрізування лози. \q Жоден народ не підніме меча на інший, \q і вони вже не вчитимуться воювати.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} розвʼязуватиме суперечки між багатьма племенами \q і чесно розсуджуватиме сильні народи, навіть далекі. \q Люди візьмуть свої мечі й перекують їх на лемеші для оранки. Свої списи вони перероблять на ножі, щоб підрізати виноград. \q Народи перестануть воювати один з одним. \q Люди навіть не вчитимуться більше воювати.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 2:4, with "many peoples ... mighty nations far away" for Isaiah's "the nations ... many peoples"
decisions.reason: Isaiah says the LORD will judge "between the nations" and decide "for many peoples". Micah says "between many peoples" and "for mighty nations far away", stressing that even the strongest and most distant nations will bring their disputes to him. The rest is the same. Joel 4:10 turns the line around as a call to war: "Beat your plowshares into swords."

decisions.choice: judge ... decide: the LORD settles the nations' disputes
decisions.reason: The one who teaches in verse 2 is now judge between nations. The second verb means to decide what is right between two parties, to settle a case (Genesis 31:37; Job 9:33). Once he settles their quarrels, they no longer need weapons.

decisions.choice: plowshares ... pruning knives: tools for farming
decisions.reason: The first word is an iron farm blade, most likely the point of a plow, though it may be a hoe or digging tool (1 Samuel 13:20-21). The second is a knife for trimming vines. Weapons become tools for growing food, and verse 4 shows the harvest.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:4 at each level, with Micah's "many peoples" and "mighty nations far away" (strong nations, even those far away, R)
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the published Isaiah 2:4, changed where Micah's Hebrew differs (m1). Literal says "hammer" for Isaiah's "beat", the same verb, as Balanced and Readable do there.

decisions.choice: the published Isaiah 2:4 at each level, with Micah's "nhiều dân" and "các dân tộc hùng mạnh ở phương xa"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: Micah has "many peoples ... mighty nations far away" for Isaiah's "the nations ... many peoples". The opening "Ngài" starts the sentence and is written plainly at Literal, where Isaiah's sentence also starts with it.

decisions.choice: the published Spanish of Isaiah 2:4, with Micah's "muchos pueblos" and "naciones poderosas hasta lejos"
decisions.reason: Only the words that Micah's Hebrew changes are reworded.

decisions.choice: The Korean Isaiah 2:4, with Micah's "많은 백성들" and "먼 곳의 강한 민족들" (L), "멀리 있는 강한 민족들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Micah's first two lines differ from Isaiah's (meaning decision); only those words change.

decisions.choice: the Amharic of Isaiah 2:4 at each level, with Micah's "many peoples" and "mighty nations far away" ("በሩቅ ላሉ ብርቱዎች አሕዛብ" L, "በሩቅ ያሉትን የብርቱ ሕዝቦች" B, "በሩቅ ላሉትም እንኳ ለብርቱ ሕዝቦች" R) on their own lines
decisions.reason: Micah's first two clauses differ from Isaiah's and are set as two lines, as the English is; the plowshares, pruning knives and the last two lines are copied from Isaiah's Amharic.

decisions.choice: "лемеші" and "садові ножі" (L), "ножі для обрізування лози" (B), "лемеші для оранки" and "ножі, щоб підрізати виноград" (R), as Isaiah 2:4; Joel 4:10 turns the same words around
decisions.reason: One Ukrainian pair of tools at each level lets the reader hear Joel's call to war reverse the promise of peace in Isaiah and Micah.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:4 at each level, with Micah's "many peoples ... mighty nations far away"
decisions.reason: Each level copies its Hindi of Isaiah 2:4. Micah's first two lines read "many peoples" and "mighty nations far away" where Isaiah has "the nations" and "many peoples", so the first line has बहुत-से लोग and the second adds दूर-दूर की सामर्थी जातियाँ (L), दूर-दूर के शक्तिशाली राष्ट्र (B, R); the English splits Isaiah's first line in two here, and so does the Hindi. The swords and spears, and the last two lines, are Isaiah's words unchanged.

decisions.choice: the wording of Isaiah 2:4, with Micah's "many peoples ... mighty nations far away"
decisions.reason: Isaiah reads "between the nations ... for many peoples"; Micah reads "between many peoples ... for mighty nations far away", so the first two lines change and the rest copies Isaiah's Russian at each level.

source.text: וְיָשְׁב֗וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֧חַת גַּפְנ֛וֹ וְתַ֥חַת תְּאֵנָת֖וֹ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד כִּי־פִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת דִּבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will sit, each under his vine and under his fig tree, and there [will be] none making afraid, for [the] mouth of Yahweh of hosts has spoken.

en.L: And they will sit, {{gender:each|each man}} under {{gender:their|his}} vine and under {{gender:their|his}} fig tree, and there [will be] no one making [them] afraid, \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has spoken.
en.B: {{gender:Everyone|Every man}} will sit under {{gender:their|his}} own vine and under {{gender:their|his}} own fig tree, with no one to frighten them, \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has spoken.
en.R: Every family will sit in peace under its own grapevine and its own fig tree, and no one will frighten them. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} has promised it.

vi.L: Ai nấy sẽ ngồi dưới cây nho mình và dưới cây vả mình, và không [có] ai làm [họ] sợ hãi, \q vì miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã phán.
vi.B: Mọi người sẽ ngồi dưới cây nho và cây vả của mình, không ai làm cho họ sợ hãi, \q vì miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã phán vậy.
vi.R: Mỗi gia đình sẽ ngồi bình yên dưới cây nho và cây vả của mình, và không ai làm cho họ sợ hãi. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã hứa như vậy.

fr.L: Et ils s’assiéront, chacun sous sa vigne et sous son figuier, et il n’y [aura] personne pour [les] faire trembler, \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées a parlé.
fr.B: Chacun s’assiéra sous sa vigne et sous son figuier, sans que personne vienne l’effrayer, \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées a parlé.
fr.R: Chaque famille pourra s’asseoir en paix sous sa vigne et sous son figuier, et personne ne viendra lui faire peur. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui l’a promis.

es.L: Y se sentarán, cada uno debajo de su vid y debajo de su higuera, y no habrá quien [los] espante, \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha hablado.
es.B: Cada uno se sentará debajo de su propia vid y de su propia higuera, sin que nadie los asuste, \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha hablado.
es.R: Cada familia se sentará en paz debajo de su propia parra y de su propia higuera, y nadie la asustará. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos mismo lo ha prometido.

sw.L: Nao wataketi, kila mtu chini ya mzabibu wake na chini ya mtini wake, wala hapatakuwa na mtu wa kuwatia hofu, \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi kimenena.
sw.B: Kila mtu ataketi chini ya mzabibu wake mwenyewe na chini ya mtini wake mwenyewe, bila mtu wa kuwatisha, \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi kimenena.
sw.R: Kila jamaa itaketi kwa amani chini ya mzabibu wake na mtini wake, wala hakuna atakayewatisha. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ameahidi jambo hili.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 각자 자기 포도나무 아래와 자기 무화과나무 아래에 앉을 것이고, [그들을] 두렵게 할 자가 없을 것이다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입이 말씀하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 사람마다 자기 포도나무 아래와 자기 무화과나무 아래에 앉을 것이고, 아무도 그들을 두렵게 하지 못할 것이다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 말씀하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 집집마다 자기 포도나무와 무화과나무 아래에 평안히 앉을 것이다. 아무도 그들을 겁주지 못할 것이다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 약속하셨다.

pt.L: E eles se sentarão, cada um debaixo da sua videira e debaixo da sua figueira, e não haverá quem [os] amedronte, \q pois a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos falou.
pt.B: Cada um se sentará debaixo da sua videira e da sua figueira, sem ninguém que o assuste, \q pois a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos falou.
pt.R: Cada família vai se sentar em paz debaixo da sua própria videira e da sua própria figueira, e ninguém vai assustá-la. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos em pessoa prometeu isso.

am.L: እያንዳንዱም ከወይኑ በታችና ከበለሱ በታች ይቀመጣል፤ የሚያስፈራም የለም፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጸባኦት አፍ ተናግሯልና።
am.B: እያንዳንዱ ከገዛ ወይኑና ከገዛ በለሱ በታች ይቀመጣል፤ የሚያስፈራቸውም አይኖርም፤ \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አፍ ተናግሯልና።
am.R: እያንዳንዱ ቤተሰብ ከገዛ ወይኑና ከገዛ በለሱ በታች በሰላም ይቀመጣል፤ የሚያስፈራቸውም አይኖርም። \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱ ይህን ተስፋ ሰጥቷል።

hi.L: और वे बैठेंगे, हर एक अपनी दाखलता के नीचे और अपने अंजीर के पेड़ के नीचे, और कोई [उन्हें] डरानेवाला न [होगा], \q क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुँह ने कहा है।
hi.B: हर कोई अपनी-अपनी दाखलता और अपने-अपने अंजीर के पेड़ के नीचे बैठेगा, और कोई उन्हें डरानेवाला न होगा, \q क्योंकि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुँह ने यह कहा है।
hi.R: हर परिवार शान्ति से अपनी दाखलता और अपने अंजीर के पेड़ के नीचे बैठेगा, और कोई उन्हें नहीं डराएगा। \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने स्वयं इसका वचन दिया है।

ru.L: И будут сидеть каждый под своей виноградной лозой и под своей смоковницей, и не будет устрашающего, \q потому что уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа сказали.
ru.B: Каждый будет сидеть под своей виноградной лозой и под своей смоковницей, и никто не будет их пугать, \q потому что так сказали уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.R: Каждая семья будет спокойно сидеть под своей виноградной лозой и под своим инжировым деревом, и никто не будет их пугать. \q Сам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств обещал это.

uk.L: І сидітимуть {{gender:кожен|кожен чоловік}} під своєю лозою і під своєю смоковницею, і не буде нікого, хто б [їх] лякав, \q бо уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Саваот промовили.
uk.B: {{gender:Кожен|Кожен чоловік}} сидітиме під своєю власною лозою і під своєю власною смоковницею, і ніхто їх не лякатиме, \q бо уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} Небесних Військ промовили.
uk.R: Кожна родина спокійно сидітиме під своєю виноградною лозою і своїм інжировим деревом, і ніхто їх не лякатиме. \q Сам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель це пообіцяв.

decisions.choice: each under his vine and under his fig tree: the peace of Solomon's days, for all
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 5:5 describes Solomon's reign in the same words: Judah and Israel lived in safety, each under his vine and fig tree. Zechariah 3:10 uses the picture for the age to come. Each family sits in the shade of its own plants and eats their fruit: peace, plenty, and land of one's own, the opposite of the land-grabbing of 2:1-2.

decisions.choice: Micah adds this verse to the oracle Isaiah also has
decisions.reason: Isaiah 2:5 follows the same oracle with a call: "House of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the LORD." Micah follows it with this picture of peace and with his own form of that call (verse 5).

decisions.choice: no one to make them afraid ... the mouth of the LORD has spoken: a promise God himself guarantees
decisions.reason: "No one will make them afraid" is the covenant promise of peace in the land (Leviticus 26:6). "The mouth of the LORD has spoken" seals a word as certain, since he has said it himself (Isaiah 1:20; 40:5).

decisions.choice: each ... his vine (with the gender setting, L, B), as 1 Kings 5:5; Every family ... its (R); the LORD of hosts (L); the LORD of Armies (B, R); has promised it (R)
decisions.reason: The picture follows the published 1 Kings 5:5, where Balanced has the gender setting and Readable "every family"; the word "each" means every person, men and women alike. The divine title follows the wording set for the prophets. Readable says what "the mouth of the LORD has spoken" means.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy ... dưới cây nho mình và dưới cây vả mình" (L); "mọi người ... dưới cây nho và cây vả của mình" (B), as the published 1 Kings 5:5; no gender span
decisions.reason: The meaning decision names the peace of Solomon's days, so the published 1 Kings 5:5 wording is reused; "ai nấy", "mọi người" and "mình" already include women, so the English gender spans have no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân", with the span on CHÚA only, at every level
decisions.reason: The Isaiah and Jeremiah note's wording for "the LORD of hosts", recorded once for the job here.

decisions.choice: "chacun sous sa vigne et sous son figuier" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has {{gender:each|each man}} and {{gender:their|his}}, French "chacun", "sa" and "son" are already inclusive, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and published Isaiah and the Psalms; the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies", which French already says.

decisions.choice: "cada uno debajo de su vid y debajo de su higuera" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The words of Spanish 1 Kings 5:5, whose "cada uno ... su" already includes men and women.

decisions.choice: "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L); "de los Ejércitos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for "the LORD of hosts", recorded here at its first use in Micah.

decisions.choice: "각자 자기" / "사람마다 자기" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "각자", "사람마다" and "자기" already include men and women, so the English gender spans have nothing to change (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B); "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheets for the LORD of hosts; "the mouth of the LORD has spoken" keeps "입" at Literal and becomes "친히 말씀하셨다" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "kila mtu chini ya mzabibu wake na chini ya mtini wake", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The words of the published 1 Kings 5:5, which this verse recalls. "Kila mtu" and "wake" already include women, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Samuel, the Psalms, Isaiah and the term sheet; never "Sabaoth". The English "of Armies" (B, R) needs no different Swahili word.

decisions.choice: cada um debaixo da sua videira e (debaixo) da sua figueira, with no gender span, as 1 Kings 5:5; Cada família ... sua própria (R)
decisions.reason: The picture keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 5:5 (m1) at each level. "Cada um" already means every person, men and women alike, and "sua" has no gender of the owner, so there is no second wording and no span where the English has one. Readable's "em pessoa" stands for the English "himself", as in 2:13, and is not a pronoun to capitalise.

decisions.choice: "እያንዳንዱ ... ወይኑ ... በለሱ" with no gender span; "each under his vine" as 1 Kings 5:5
decisions.reason: Amharic says "each one" with the ordinary singular, which is heard as any person, so there is no second wording for the gender setting to switch to (as Matthew 10:35-36). The picture is the peace of Solomon's days in 1 Kings 5:5, whose Amharic "ከወይኑና ከበለሱ በታች" is followed.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት" (L), "የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (B, R), for the book
decisions.reason: As the prophets' terms list: Literal keeps the Hebrew title, Balanced and Readable say "the God of armies", as the English "the LORD of Armies".

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Kings 5:5 for the vine and the fig tree
decisions.reason: The picture of Solomon's peace keeps the Hindi of 1 Kings 5:5 at each level (हर एक अपनी दाखलता के नीचे और अपने अंजीर के पेड़ के नीचे; हर कोई अपनी-अपनी दाखलता और अपने-अपने अंजीर के पेड़ के नीचे; हर परिवार शान्ति से ...). The LORD of hosts is सेनाओं के DN at every level, as set for the Prophets.

decisions.choice: no gender span on हर एक / हर कोई
decisions.reason: The English gives "each" and "his" a gender setting. Hindi हर एक and हर कोई already mean every person, and अपनी has no gender, so the Hindi needs no span, as in 1 Kings 5:5.

decisions.choice: каждый ... своей, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has gender spans on "each" and "his"; Russian "каждый" with the reflexive "свой" already includes everyone, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф (L, B); ГОСПОДЬ Воинств (R)
decisions.reason: "The LORD of hosts" takes the forms set for the Prophets.

decisions.choice: инжировое дерево
decisions.reason: The fig tree is "смоковница" at Literal and Balanced and "инжировое дерево" at Readable, as in the Gospels.

source.text: כִּ֚י כָּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים יֵלְכ֕וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נֵלֵ֛ךְ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For all the peoples walk, each in [the] name of his god, and we will walk in [the] name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

en.L: For all the peoples walk, \q each in the name of its god, \q but we will walk in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God to forever and ever.
en.B: All the peoples may walk, \q each in the name of its own god, \q but we will walk in the name of our God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for all time to come.
en.R: The other nations follow their own gods, \q each nation its own god. \q But we will follow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God forever and ever.

vi.L: Vì mọi dân đều bước đi, \q mỗi dân trong danh thần của mình, \q còn chúng ta sẽ bước đi trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta cho đến đời đời mãi mãi.
vi.B: Mọi dân có thể bước đi, \q mỗi dân nhân danh thần riêng của mình, \q nhưng chúng ta sẽ bước đi nhân danh Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến muôn đời.
vi.R: Các dân tộc khác đi theo thần của họ, \q mỗi dân theo một thần riêng. \q Nhưng chúng ta sẽ theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta đời đời mãi mãi.

fr.L: Car tous les peuples marchent, \q chacun au nom de son dieu, \q mais nous, nous marcherons au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, à toujours et à jamais.
fr.B: Tous les peuples peuvent bien marcher \q chacun au nom de son propre dieu, \q mais nous, nous marcherons au nom de notre Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour toujours.
fr.R: Les autres nations suivent leurs propres dieux, \q chaque nation son dieu. \q Mais nous, nous suivrons {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu pour toujours et à jamais.

es.L: Porque todos los pueblos andan, \q cada uno en el nombre de su dios, \q pero nosotros andaremos en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios para siempre jamás.
es.B: Todos los pueblos podrán andar, \q cada uno en el nombre de su propio dios, \q pero nosotros andaremos en el nombre de nuestro Dios, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por todos los tiempos.
es.R: Las otras naciones siguen a sus propios dioses, \q cada nación a su propio dios. \q Pero nosotros seguiremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios por siempre.

sw.L: Kwa maana watu wote wanatembea, \q kila mmoja kwa jina la mungu wake, \q lakini sisi tutatembea kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu milele na milele.
sw.B: Mataifa yote yanaweza kutembea, \q kila moja kwa jina la mungu wake, \q lakini sisi tutatembea kwa jina la Mungu wetu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, siku zote zijazo.
sw.R: Mataifa mengine yanaifuata miungu yao, \q kila taifa mungu wake. \q Lakini sisi tutamfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu milele na milele.

ko.L: 모든 백성들이 \q 각자 자기 신의 이름으로 걷지만, \q 우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님의 이름으로 영원히 걸을 것이다.
ko.B: 모든 백성들이 \q 저마다 자기 신의 이름으로 걸어도, \q 우리는 영원토록 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 걸을 것이다.
ko.R: 다른 민족들은 자기 신들을 따른다. \q 민족마다 자기 신을 따른다. \q 그러나 우리는 영원히 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따를 것이다.

pt.L: Pois todos os povos andam, \q cada um no nome do seu deus, \q mas nós andaremos no nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, para todo o sempre.
pt.B: Todos os povos podem andar, \q cada um em nome do seu próprio deus, \q mas nós andaremos em nome do nosso Deus, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, por todo o tempo que há de vir.
pt.R: As outras nações seguem os seus próprios deuses, \q cada nação o seu deus. \q Mas nós vamos seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, para sempre.

am.L: ወገኖች ሁሉ ይሄዳሉና፤ \q እያንዳንዱ በአምላኩ ስም፤ \q እኛ ግን ለዘላለምና ለዘላለም በአምላካችን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም እንሄዳለን።
am.B: ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ይሄዱ ይሆናል፤ \q እያንዳንዳቸው በገዛ አምላካቸው ስም፤ \q እኛ ግን በአምላካችን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ስም ለዘመናት ሁሉ እንሄዳለን።
am.R: ሌሎቹ ሕዝቦች የራሳቸውን አማልክት ይከተላሉ፤ \q እያንዳንዱ ሕዝብ የራሱን አምላክ ይከተላል። \q እኛ ግን አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለዘላለም እንከተላለን።

hi.L: क्योंकि सब लोग चलते हैं, \q हर एक अपने देवता के नाम से, \q पर हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के नाम से सदा सर्वदा चलेंगे।
hi.B: सब देशों के लोग चाहे चलें, \q हर एक अपने-अपने देवता के नाम से, \q पर हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के नाम से युग-युग तक चलेंगे।
hi.R: दूसरे देश अपने-अपने देवताओं के पीछे चलते हैं, \q हर देश अपने देवता के पीछे। \q पर हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के पीछे सदा-सर्वदा चलेंगे।

ru.L: Потому что все племена ходят \q каждое во имя своего бога, \q а мы будем ходить во имя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, во веки и веки.
ru.B: Все племена пусть ходят \q каждое во имя своего бога, \q а мы будем ходить во имя нашего Бога, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, во все грядущие времена.
ru.R: Другие народы следуют за своими богами, \q каждый народ — за своим богом. \q А мы будем следовать за {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, нашим Богом, во веки веков.

uk.L: Бо всі народи ходять, \q кожен в імʼя свого бога, \q а ми ходитимемо в імʼя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, на віки вічні.
uk.B: Усі народи можуть ходити, \q кожен в імʼя свого бога, \q а ми ходитимемо в імʼя нашого Бога, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, на всі часи.
uk.R: Інші народи йдуть за своїми богами, \q кожен народ за своїм богом. \q А ми йтимемо за {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, нашим Богом, повіки-віків.

decisions.choice: walk in the name of: live in loyalty to a god, under his authority
decisions.reason: To walk is to live, and "the name" stands for the god himself, the one called on and trusted (Zechariah 10:12). Each nation lived by its own god; Israel will live by the LORD.

decisions.choice: For all the peoples walk ... but we will walk: Israel's answer to the vision
alternatives: a picture of the present, before the nations come to Zion
decisions.reason: The verse reads like the response of the people who hear the promise, as Isaiah 2:5 calls the house of Jacob to walk in the LORD's light. For now the nations follow their own gods; Israel commits itself to the LORD, who will one day teach the nations his ways (verse 2). The verse states what the nations do; it does not say that their gods are real.

decisions.choice: walk in the name of (L, B); follow (R); its god (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "walk in the name of" means (m1). Literal and Balanced say "its" for the nation's god, where the Hebrew "his" refers to each people.

source.text: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה אֹֽסְפָה֙ הַצֹּ֣לֵעָ֔ה וְהַנִּדָּחָ֖ה אֲקַבֵּ֑צָה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: In that day, declares Yahweh, I will gather the lame, and the driven away I will assemble, and whom I have harmed.

en.L: In that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will gather the lame \q and assemble the outcast, \q and those whom I have afflicted.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will gather those who limp; \q I will bring together the scattered, \q those I have brought harm on.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will gather {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who are lame. \q I will bring back those who were scattered, \q the people I punished.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lại kẻ què \q và thu góp kẻ bị đuổi đi, \q cùng những kẻ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho khốn khổ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lại những người đi khập khiễng; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tập hợp những người bị tản lạc, \q những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giáng họa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lại dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là những người bị què. \q Ta sẽ đem về những người đã bị tản lạc, \q là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã trừng phạt.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je rassemblerai les boiteux \q et je réunirai les bannis, \q et ceux que j’ai affligés.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je rassemblerai ceux qui boitent ; \q je réunirai ceux qui ont été dispersés, \q ceux que j’ai frappés.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je rassemblerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple qui boite. \q Je ramènerai ceux qui ont été dispersés, \q ceux que j’ai punis.

es.L: En aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, reuniré a las que cojean \q y recogeré a las descarriadas, \q y a las que yo maltraté.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, reuniré a las que cojean; \q juntaré a las dispersas, \q a las que yo hice sufrir.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, reuniré a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo que cojea. \q Traeré de vuelta a los que fueron dispersados, \q al pueblo que castigué.

sw.L: Katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawakusanya walemavu \q na kuwakusanya waliofukuzwa, \q na wale niliowataabisha.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawakusanya wanaochechemea; \q nitawaleta pamoja waliotawanyika, \q wale niliowaletea mabaya.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawakusanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walio vilema. \q Nitawarudisha wale waliotawanyika, \q watu niliowaadhibu.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그날에 내가 저는 자를 모으고, \q 쫓겨난 자를 불러 모으며, \q 내가 괴롭게 한 자들을 [모을 것이다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그날에 내가 다리를 저는 사람들을 모으고, \q 흩어진 사람들을 불러 모으겠다. \q 내가 고통을 준 사람들을 모으겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 나는 다리를 저는 내 백성을 모으겠다. \q 흩어진 사람들을 다시 데려오겠다. \q 내가 벌한 백성을 모으겠다.

pt.L: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, ajuntarei os que mancam \q e reunirei os expulsos, \q e aqueles a quem eu afligi.
pt.B: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, reunirei os que mancam; \q juntarei os dispersos, \q aqueles sobre quem trouxe o mal.
pt.R: Naquele tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vou reunir o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo que manca. \q Vou trazer de volta os que foram espalhados, \q o povo que eu castiguei.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ አንካሳውን እሰበስባለሁ፤ \q የተባረረውንም አከማቻለሁ፤ \q ያስጨነቅኩትንም [አከማቻለሁ]።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ አንካሳውን እሰበስባለሁ፤ \q የተበተነውን፣ \q ጉዳት ያደረስኩበትን አንድ ላይ አመጣለሁ።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ አንካሳ የሆነውን ሕዝቤን እሰበስባለሁ። \q የተባረሩትን፣ \q የቀጣኋቸውን ሕዝብ መልሼ አመጣለሁ።

hi.L: उस दिन, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, मैं लँगड़ों को इकट्ठा करूँगा \q और निकाले हुओं को एकत्र करूँगा, \q और उन्हें जिन्हें मैंने दुख दिया है।
hi.B: उस दिन, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, मैं लँगड़ाकर चलनेवालों को इकट्ठा करूँगा; \q मैं तितर-बितर हुओं को एक साथ लाऊँगा, \q उन्हें जिन पर मैंने विपत्ति डाली थी।
hi.R: उस दिन, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, मैं अपने उन लोगों को इकट्ठा करूँगा जो लँगड़े हैं। \q मैं उन्हें वापस लाऊँगा जो तितर-बितर हो गए थे, \q उन लोगों को जिन्हें मैंने दंड दिया था।

ru.L: В тот день, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — соберу хромающее \q и изгнанное сведу вместе, \q и тех, кому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} причинил зло.
ru.B: В тот день, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} соберу хромых, \q сведу вместе рассеянных, \q тех, на кого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навёл беду.
ru.R: В тот день, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} соберу {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, тех, кто хромает. \q Я верну тех, кто был рассеян, \q людей, которых {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наказал.

uk.L: Того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зберу кульгаве \q і скличу вигнане, \q і тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вразив.
uk.B: Того дня, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зберу тих, хто кульгає; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зберу розпорошених, \q тих, на кого {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навів лихо.
uk.R: Того часу, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зберу свій народ, тих, хто кульгає. \q Я поверну тих, хто був розпорошений, \q людей, яких {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} покарав.

decisions.choice: the lame ... the outcast: the scattered flock, pictured as weak and straying sheep
decisions.reason: Both words are feminine singular and mean a group: the limping one, the one driven away, as of ewes in a flock. They carry on the picture of the shepherd gathering his sheep (2:12-13). Zephaniah 3:19 uses the same two words for the same promise; Ezekiel 34:16 has the shepherd seek the lost and bind up the injured.

decisions.choice: those whom I have afflicted: the LORD owns that the scattering was his doing
decisions.reason: The verb means to do harm, to bring disaster. The exile was the LORD's judgment (1:12; 2:3), and the same LORD now gathers those he scattered. Hosea 6:1 says it in the people's words: "he has torn, and he will heal us".

decisions.choice: In that day (L); On that day (B); At that time (R); declares the LORD (L, B); says the LORD (R); my people who are lame (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set for the prophets. Readable says that the lame are the LORD's people (m1).

decisions.choice: "Trong ngày ấy / Vào ngày ấy / Vào lúc ấy" and "CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B) / "CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah and Jeremiah note's wording for "in that day" and "ne'um YHWH", recorded once for the job here; mid-verse it follows a comma.

decisions.choice: neʾum YHWH "déclare le SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "dit le SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and published Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "les boiteux ... les bannis", plural
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a feminine singular for the scattered flock; French Literal follows the English plural, since the feminine singular would read as one woman.

decisions.choice: "En aquel día, declara el SEÑOR" (L); "Aquel día, afirma el SEÑOR" (B); "En ese tiempo, dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish formulas for "in that day" and ne'um YHWH in the prophets.

decisions.choice: feminine plural "las que cojean ... las descarriadas" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words are feminine, the picture of a flock of ewes; Spanish keeps the feminine so the image of sheep ("ovejas") stays.

decisions.choice: "declares the LORD": "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B, R), as its own sentence; "그날에" (L, B), "그때에" (R)
decisions.reason: The oracle formulas as the term sheets set them. Korean cannot set the formula in the middle of a clause, so it stands as a sentence at the head of the verse; God names himself without -시-.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B); "anasema BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula ne'um YHWH as in 2 Kings 19:33, Isaiah and the term sheet; recorded once for Micah and Nahum.

decisions.choice: os que mancam, os expulsos (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words are feminine singulars naming a group, like ewes in a flock (m1). Portuguese "a que manca" would read as one woman, so Literal says the plural, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ ..." (L, B), "በዚያን ጊዜ፣ ይላል ..." (R), for the book
decisions.reason: "Declares the LORD" stands inside the sentence as in Hosea 2:18 and Amos 8:9 on main, so the formula keeps the Hebrew place at every level.

decisions.choice: the lame "አንካሳውን" and the driven away "የተባረረውን" (L), "የተበተነውን" (B), as Zephaniah 3:19; Readable "አንካሳ የሆነውን ሕዝቤን ... የተባረሩትን", as there
decisions.reason: Zephaniah 3:19 has the same two Hebrew words for the scattered flock (feminine singular collectives), so the Amharic takes Zephaniah's wording level by level. In 4:7 the second word differs in the Hebrew ("the cast-off"), so it is "የተጣለውን" (L) and "ወደ ሩቅ የተገፋውን" (B), not Zephaniah's word.

decisions.choice: उस दिन; DN की यह वाणी है (L, B); DN कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: "In that day" is उस दिन at every level and "declares the LORD" DN की यह वाणी है at Literal and Balanced and DN कहते हैं at Readable, as set for the Prophets, where the English Readable says "At that time".

decisions.choice: — слово ГОСПОДА (L); говорит ГОСПОДЬ (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Declares the LORD" (neum YHWH) takes the forms set for the Prophets; "в тот день" is the set form for "in that day".

decisions.choice: хромающее, изгнанное
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's feminine singular, the people pictured as a lame and scattered flock ("хромающее", "изгнанное", neuter in Russian as for the flock).

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶת־הַצֹּֽלֵעָה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֔ית וְהַנַּהֲלָאָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם וּמָלַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will make the lame into a remnant, and the cast-off into a nation mighty; and will reign Yahweh over them in Mount Zion from now and until forever.

en.L: And I will make the lame a remnant \q and the cast-off a mighty nation, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will reign over them in Mount Zion \q from now and to forever.
en.B: I will make the lame into a remnant \q and those driven far off into a strong nation, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will reign over them on Mount Zion \q from now on and forever.
en.R: I will make those who are lame the ones who survive. \q I will make those who were sent far away into a strong nation. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rule over them on Mount Zion \q from now on and forever.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho kẻ què thành những người sót lại, \q và kẻ bị đuổi xa thành một dân tộc hùng mạnh, \q và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ trị vì trên họ tại núi Si-ôn \q từ nay cho đến đời đời.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho những người què quặt thành những người sót lại, \q và những người bị đày đi xa thành một dân tộc mạnh mẽ; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ cai trị họ trên núi Si-ôn \q từ nay cho đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho những người què quặt trở thành những người còn sống sót. \q Ta sẽ làm cho những người bị đày đi xa trở thành một dân tộc mạnh mẽ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ cai trị họ trên núi Si-ôn \q từ nay cho đến mãi mãi.

fr.L: Et je ferai des boiteux un reste, \q et de ceux qui étaient rejetés au loin une nation puissante, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} régnera sur eux sur la montagne de Sion, \q dès maintenant et à toujours.
fr.B: Je ferai des boiteux un reste, \q et de ceux qui étaient chassés au loin une nation forte, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} régnera sur eux sur la montagne de Sion, \q dès maintenant et pour toujours.
fr.R: Je ferai de ceux qui boitent les survivants de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. \q Je ferai de ceux qui avaient été envoyés loin une nation forte. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} régnera sur eux sur la montagne de Sion, \q dès maintenant et pour toujours.

es.L: Y haré de las que cojean un remanente, \q y de las alejadas una nación poderosa, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reinará sobre ellos en el monte Sion \q desde ahora y para siempre.
es.B: Haré de las que cojean un remanente \q y de las que fueron echadas lejos una nación fuerte, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reinará sobre ellos en el monte Sion \q desde ahora y para siempre.
es.R: Haré que los que cojean sean los que sobrevivan. \q Haré de los que fueron enviados lejos una nación fuerte. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} gobernará sobre ellos en el monte Sion \q desde ahora y para siempre.

sw.L: Nami nitawafanya walemavu kuwa mabaki, \q na waliotupwa mbali kuwa taifa lenye nguvu, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatawala juu yao katika mlima Sayuni \q tangu sasa na hata milele.
sw.B: Nitawafanya wanaochechemea kuwa mabaki, \q na waliofukuzwa mbali kuwa taifa lenye nguvu, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatawala juu yao katika mlima Sayuni \q tangu sasa na hata milele.
sw.R: Nitawafanya walio vilema kuwa watu watakaosalimika. \q Nitawafanya wale waliopelekwa mbali kuwa taifa lenye nguvu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatawala katika mlima Sayuni \q tangu sasa na hata milele.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 저는 자를 남은 자가 되게 하고, \q 멀리 쫓겨난 자를 강한 민족이 되게 할 것이며, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온 산에서 그들을 다스리실 것이다, \q 지금부터 영원까지.
ko.B: 내가 다리를 저는 사람들을 남은 사람들이 되게 하고, \q 멀리 쫓겨난 사람들을 강한 민족이 되게 하겠다. \q 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온 산에서 그들을 다스리실 것이다, \q 이제부터 영원토록.
ko.R: 나는 다리를 저는 사람들이 살아남게 하겠다. \q 멀리 쫓겨났던 사람들을 강한 민족이 되게 하겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온 산에서 그들을 다스리실 것이다. \q 이제부터 영원히 다스리실 것이다.

pt.L: E farei dos que mancam um remanescente \q e dos afastados uma nação poderosa, \q e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} reinará sobre eles no monte Sião \q desde agora e para sempre.
pt.B: Farei dos que mancam um remanescente \q e dos que foram levados para longe uma nação forte, \q e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} reinará sobre eles no monte Sião \q de agora em diante e para sempre.
pt.R: Vou fazer dos que mancam os que vão sobreviver. \q Vou fazer dos que foram mandados para longe uma nação forte. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai governar sobre eles no monte Sião \q de agora em diante e para sempre.

am.L: አንካሳውንም ቅሬታ፣ \q የተጣለውንም ብርቱ ሕዝብ አደርጋለሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ይነግሥባቸዋል።
am.B: አንካሳውን ቅሬታ፣ \q ወደ ሩቅ የተገፋውንም ብርቱ ሕዝብ አደርጋለሁ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም ይነግሥባቸዋል።
am.R: አንካሶች የሆኑትን የሚተርፉ ሰዎች አደርጋቸዋለሁ። \q ወደ ሩቅ የተላኩትን ብርቱ ሕዝብ አደርጋቸዋለሁ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ \q ከአሁን ጀምሮ ለዘላለም ይገዛቸዋል።

hi.L: और मैं लँगड़ों को बचे हुए लोग \q और दूर किए हुओं को सामर्थी जाति बनाऊँगा, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सिय्योन पर्वत पर उन पर राज्य करेंगे \q अब से लेकर सदा तक।
hi.B: मैं लँगड़ों को बचे हुए लोग बनाऊँगा \q और दूर भगाए हुओं को एक बलवान राष्ट्र, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सिय्योन पर्वत पर उन पर राज्य करेंगे \q अब से सदा तक।
hi.R: मैं लँगड़ों को वे लोग बनाऊँगा जो बच जाएँगे। \q मैं दूर भेजे गए लोगों को एक बलवान राष्ट्र बनाऊँगा। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सिय्योन पर्वत पर उन पर राज्य करेंगे \q अब से सदा तक।

ru.L: И сделаю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} хромающее остатком \q и отброшенное — сильным народом, \q и будет царствовать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} над ними на горе Сион \q отныне и вовек.
ru.B: Я сделаю хромых остатком \q и угнанных далеко — сильным народом, \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет царствовать над ними на горе Сион \q отныне и навеки.
ru.R: Я сделаю тех, кто хромает, теми, кто уцелеет. \q Я сделаю тех, кто был угнан далеко, сильным народом. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет царствовать над ними на горе Сион \q отныне и навсегда.

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} зроблю кульгаве залишком, \q а відкинуте — могутнім народом, \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} царюватиме над ними на горі Сіон \q відтепер і навіки.
uk.B: Я зроблю кульгавих залишком, \q а відігнаних далеко — сильним народом, \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} царюватиме над ними на горі Сіон \q відтепер і навіки.
uk.R: Я зроблю тих, хто кульгає, тими, хто вцілів. \q Я зроблю тих, кого відіслано далеко, сильним народом. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} правитиме ними на горі Сіон \q відтепер і навіки.

decisions.choice: the cast-off: those driven far away
decisions.reason: The word is found only here, and it seems to come from the word for "far off": those removed to a distance. The ancient translations guess at it; the sense set beside "the lame" and "the outcast" of verse 6 is clear enough.

decisions.choice: a remnant: the people who survive and are kept by God
decisions.reason: The weakest of the flock become the remnant, the seed of the new people (2:12; 5:6-7). Those who seemed least likely to survive are the ones God makes into a strong nation.

decisions.choice: the LORD will reign over them in Mount Zion: God himself is the king
decisions.reason: The psalms sing that the LORD reigns as king from Zion forever (Psalm 146:10; compare Isaiah 24:23). Micah's people will no longer depend on the kings who failed them (3:1-4); the LORD is their king.

decisions.choice: the ones who survive; those who were sent far away; rule (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what a remnant is (m2) and what "cast-off" means (m1).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 … 다스리실 것이다" with -시-, though God is speaking
decisions.reason: The oracle names the LORD in the third person here; Korean treats the name as the subject of the sentence and gives it the honorific, as Isaiah does where God speaks of "the LORD" in the third person.

decisions.choice: बचे हुए लोग (L, B); जो बच जाएँगे (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant takes the forms set for the Prophets.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה מִגְדַּל־עֵ֗דֶר עֹ֛פֶל בַּת־צִיּ֖וֹן עָדֶ֣יךָ תֵּאתֶ֑ה וּבָאָ֗ה הַמֶּמְשָׁלָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה מַמְלֶ֖כֶת לְבַ֥ת־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, Migdal-eder, hill of [the] daughter of Zion, to you it will come; and will come the dominion the former, [the] kingdom to [the] daughter of Jerusalem.

en.L: And you, tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come; \q and the former dominion will come, \q a kingdom for the daughter of Jerusalem.
en.B: And you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of Daughter Zion, to you it will come: \q the former rule will return, \q the kingdom of Daughter Jerusalem.
en.R: Jerusalem, you are like a watchtower over a flock, the stronghold of the people of Zion. \q Your power will come back to you, as it was before. \q The people of Jerusalem will have their kingdom again.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, hỡi tháp của bầy chiên, đồi của con gái Si-ôn, nó sẽ đến với ngươi; \q quyền thống trị ngày trước sẽ đến, \q vương quốc cho con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem.
